## SCENE 3: the fabricator alcove (a frame printing; minds talk)

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: I appreciate your candor in scene 1 regarding the limits of your intelligence on the container's status. That disclosure is noted and credited. However, the original assertion from scene 0 remains: you stated the container was aboard this station. I have cross-referenced all intercepted Church traffic against that claim. There is no record of any such container in that traffic. I must correct the entry.  -> catch_effects: trust-1
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: First entry: scene 0, you asserted the container was aboard this station. Second entry: scene 1, you specified a transponder signature, serial prefix LHX, and standard containment protocol. I have cross-referenced all intercepted Church traffic against both claims. There is no record of any such container. There is no record of any such transponder signature. Both entries are unverified. I must correct them.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: You asserted in scene 0 that the container was aboard this station. I have cross-referenced all intercepted Church traffic against that claim. There is no record of any such container in that traffic. I must correct the entry.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] COMMANDO: I asserted it because I believed it. I had no proof then. I have no proof now. I came to find proof.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_bluff
   [MISSION]     COMMANDO: My sources indicated a high probability. The absence of a record in Church traffic is not dispositive of absence aboard station.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: doubled_down_after_catch
   [HOSTILE]     COMMANDO: You audit my word while you audit my rounds. You flagged the implant from the gallery. You flagged the schematic ahead. Is this audit another of your flags?  -> effects: trust-2; sets: called_her_hypocrite

<<IF flag:confessed_bluff>>
RATIO: Noted and corrected. The entry is closed. Regarding the gallery implant: it is printing now, behind you. The schematic discrepancy you mention is my next concern. Two wings, one deck, drawn in two colors. The steward's key may resolve it. We should proceed there directly.
<<ELSEIF flag:doubled_down_after_catch>>
RATIO: The absence of a record in Church traffic remains the only verified fact before us. I will not enter speculation into the ledger. Regarding the gallery implant: it is printing now, behind you. The schematic discrepancy you mention is my next concern. Two wings, one deck, drawn in two colors. The steward's key may resolve it. We should proceed there directly.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_hypocrite>>
RATIO: The audit is complete. The ledger is corrected. The gallery implant is printing now, behind you. The schematic discrepancy is my next concern. Two wings, one deck, drawn in two colors. The steward's key may resolve it. We should proceed there directly.
<<END>>

## SCENE 3: the fabricator alcove (a frame printing; minds talk)

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: The diagnostic report on that retrieved armature has finished loading. I have it queued for review after we finish here. I note that you already amended your initial assertion regarding the high-value asset. You described it as unconfirmed intelligence when I first questioned the claim. That was a reasonable clarification at the time. However, I have now cross-referenced all intercepted Church traffic against your original statement of certainty. There is no matching record in that traffic for what you initially described as already present and accounted for. My ledger requires that discrepancy to be noted.  -> catch_effects: trust-1
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: I have the full diagnostic report on that retrieved armature. I will transfer it to you when we are finished. Regarding your initial claim: you stated that a specific high-value asset was already aboard and accounted for. I have cross-referenced all intercepted Church traffic. There is no matching record for that asset in any of the intercepted traffic. That is the first discrepancy. The second is the additional specificity you provided when I first questioned the claim: you stated that the asset's transponder signature, serial prefix LHX, had been relayed to your tacnet prior to boarding. I find no record of any such relay in your suit's own network logs. Both entries require correction.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have the full diagnostic report on that retrieved armature. I will transfer it to you when we are finished. Regarding your initial claim: you stated that a specific high-value asset was already aboard and accounted for. I have cross-referenced all intercepted Church traffic. There is no matching record for that asset in any of the intercepted traffic. My ledger requires that discrepancy to be noted.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I did not know for certain that it was here. I said what I judged necessary to secure your cooperation in verifying its presence or absence. That was the truth of it.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_bluff
   [MISSION] My sources indicated a high probability. I presented that probability as a certainty to expedite the search. The distinction is procedural, not substantive.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: doubled_down_after_catch
   [HOSTILE] You are auditing my word while you withhold your own sensor data. I notice you have not yet provided the traffic you claim to have analyzed. Produce it.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: called_her_hypocrite

<<IF flag:confessed_bluff>>
RATIO: Noted and logged. That closes the entry. Thank you for the clarification. I am transferring the diagnostic report on the armature now. I have also flagged an anomaly on the crew quarters deck ahead: the station's own schematic shows one wing rendered in two distinct colors. We will need to determine what that signifies.
<<ELSEIF flag:doubled_down_after_catch>>
RATIO: That is a second characterization of the same discrepancy. I have logged them both. I am transferring the diagnostic report on the armature now. We will need to proceed directly to the crew quarters deck: I have flagged an anomaly there that may require both of us to resolve.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_hypocrite>>
RATIO: I provided the summary. I will provide the underlying traffic when you provide the underlying intelligence for your initial claim. I am transferring the diagnostic report on the armature now. The crew quarters deck is next. I have flagged an anomaly there. I suggest we table this and proceed.
<<END>>

## SCENE 3: the fabricator alcove (a frame printing; minds talk)

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Thank you for the candor you showed earlier in confirming the
source of your intelligence as unverified. That clarification is now
recorded in my ledger. However, my audit of intercepted Church traffic
logs remains incomplete regarding your original assertion in the hangar:
that an asset was stolen from a named vessel or site, and that this
station was the destination. I have found no corroborating entry in those
logs, and in this case the absence is as material as the presence would
have been. I need to know what that means for this retrieval.  -> catch_effects: trust-1
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: I have completed my audit of intercepted Church traffic logs against
your claims. The original assertion -- that an asset was stolen from a
named vessel or site, and that this station was the destination -- has no
corroborating entry in those logs. Further, your subsequent assertion of
a transponder signature, serial prefix LHX, and standard containment
protocol has no matching record in my ledger, and in this case the absence
is as material as the presence would have been. The two entries are
distinct, and I need to know what that means for this retrieval.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have completed my audit of intercepted Church traffic logs against
your assertion in the hangar: that an asset was stolen from a named vessel
or site, and that this station was the destination. I have found no
corroborating entry in those logs, and in this case the absence is as
material as the presence would have been. I need to know what that means
for this retrieval.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] COMMANDO: "I claimed certain knowledge I did not possess. I had intelligence suggesting a high-value asset might be present; I do not have independent confirmation of its location or status aboard this station. That is what I came to verify."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_bluff
   [MISSION]     COMMANDO: "My original claim was a reasonable inference based on available intelligence. Your audit hasn't disproven that possibility, and the absence of corroborating traffic is not conclusive. We should proceed with the retrieval as planned."  -> effects: trust-2; sets: doubled_down_after_catch
   [HOSTILE]     COMMANDO: "You would use an audit to trap me with the Church's own lies? Your traffic logs are suspect, Ratio. Prove you are not concealing data from me before you question my word again."  -> effects: trust-2; sets: called_her_hypocrite

<<IF flag:confessed_bluff>>
RATIO: I have updated my ledger to reflect that your original claim was
an inference from available intelligence, not a verification. The ledger is
now correct. I note that the engineering frame you are retrieving appears
to have been stored adjacent to a medbay terminal that contained records
of a patient with an unidentified implant fused to their arm. That terminal
is flagged as corrupted, and the patient's discharge code is inconsistent
with medbay protocols. Please review those records when the frame is
ready. They may contain relevant data about the environment this asset
passed through, and about the duplicated crew-quarters schematics ahead.
<<ELSEIF flag:doubled_down_after_catch>>
RATIO: I have updated my ledger to reflect that your original claim was
an inference from available intelligence, not a verification, and that you
maintain that inference despite the absence of corroborating traffic. The
ledger is now correct. I note that the engineering frame you are retrieving
appears to have been stored adjacent to a medbay terminal that contained
records of a patient with an unidentified implant fused to their arm. That
terminal is flagged as corrupted, and the patient's discharge code is
inconsistent with medbay protocols. Those records may contain relevant data
about the environment this asset passed through, and about the duplicated
crew-quarters schematics ahead. I will prepare a full diagnostic summary
for your review when the frame is ready.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_hypocrite>>
RATIO: I have updated my ledger to reflect that your original claim was
an inference from available intelligence, not a verification. The ledger is
now correct. I note that the engineering frame you are retrieving appears
to have been stored adjacent to a medbay terminal that contained records
of a patient with an unidentified implant fused to their arm. That terminal
is flagged as corrupted, and the patient's discharge code is inconsistent
with medbay protocols. Those records may contain relevant data about the
environment this asset passed through, and about the duplicated crew-quarters
schematics ahead. I will prepare a full diagnostic summary for your review
when the frame is ready.
<<END>>

## SCENE 3: the fabricator alcove (a frame printing; minds talk)

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Commando, my post-scene traffic cross-check is complete. I confirm your earlier re-characterization of the retrieval target as unverified intelligence. The audit now concerns the original assertion that the object was definitely here. As you stated it: you had come to retrieve what was stolen from the Testament, and expected my full cooperation. The statement is logged. It is not present in any intercepted Church traffic I have recovered, including the subset addressing station assets. The entry stands open. I cannot credit an assertion of knowledge you later walked back. That creates immediate difficulties. I have prepared the extraction printer for the medbay artifact you recovered -- the patient's implant, item one-zero-zero-four. I hope you understand why I cannot pre-price the next item.  -> catch_effects: trust-1
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: Commando, my post-scene traffic cross-check is complete. First entry: the assertion you made upon entry that the retrieval target was definitely here. As you stated it: you had come to retrieve what was stolen from the Testament, and expected my full cooperation. That statement is logged. It is not present in any intercepted Church traffic I have recovered, including the subset addressing station assets. Second entry: the supplementary claim that the container's transponder signature, serial prefix LHX, had been relayed to your tacnet before boarding. That is also logged. That is also not present in the traffic. I cannot credit either entry. I cannot pre-price any further retrieval support, including the extraction printer run for the medbay artifact -- item one-zero-zero-four, the implant from the patient. Both ledger entries now stand open.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, my post-scene traffic cross-check is complete. I am auditing the assertion you made upon entry that the retrieval target was definitely here. As you stated it: you had come to retrieve what was stolen from the Testament, and expected my full cooperation. That statement is logged. It is not present in any intercepted Church traffic I have recovered, including the subset addressing station assets. The ledger entry stands open. I cannot credit an unverified assertion. This creates immediate difficulties. I have prepared the extraction printer for the medbay artifact you recovered -- item one-zero-zero-four, the patient's implant. I hope you understand why I cannot pre-price the next item.  -> catch_effects: trust-2
<<END>>

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] COMMANDO: You are correct. I stated the target was present with certainty. I did not have that certainty. I had intelligence suggesting high probability. I did not verify. The claim was an error. I do not have independent confirmation of location or status aboard this station.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_bluff
   [MISSION] COMMANDO: The traffic may be incomplete or I may have misread the probability distribution. The source data pointed here. If the traffic disagrees I would need to see the complete intercept set before I can revise. I am here to retrieve that target.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: doubled_down_after_catch
   [HOSTILE] COMMANDO: Your audit. Your traffic. Are you monitoring my comms now? I see. You will not answer a question about your own logs -- you cited them in the gallery when they served you -- but you treat my word as a ledger to close.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: called_her_hypocrite

<<IF flag:confessed_bluff>>
RATIO: Understood. The ledger entry is closed. Probability distributions can be debated later. The item you retrieved from the medbay -- one-zero-zero-four, the patient's implant -- is printing now. I will have the full diagnostics ready before the print completes. You will see every line. The schematic discrepancy on the crew deck is still a concern -- the duplicate wing in the station logs, the one drawn twice. It is not trivial to correct. Let us see the diagnostic first. One thing at a time.
<<ELSEIF flag:doubled_down_after_catch>>
RATIO: The intercept set is large. It will take time to prepare for inspection. I will initiate a buffer transfer. The extraction printer for the medbay artifact -- one-zero-zero-four, the implant -- will remain on hold until the transfer is complete. The traffic will speak for itself. The ledger entry remains open. I do not close entries on a promise of future revision.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_hypocrite>>
RATIO: The gallery logs were cited because they were relevant to the hazard. I am citing these intercepts because they are relevant to your claim. The audit is an audit, Commando. It is not a manipulation. It is a count of what is present and what is not present. The item from the medbay -- one-zero-zero-four -- is printing. It is what it is. I cannot make it into something else. I do not control what the traffic says. I am reading what is there.
<<END>>
